name: west block of the south arch building (external stair, green-door annexe)

notes.facade: e6 = north face (6.6 m, R19), u from the east end next to the arch. 01/17: 2 storeys, cornice level with the pedimented block (~11 m), three tall rectangular grilled windows upstairs, a small round-arched grilled window and a grey door (reached by an external stair of ~7 steps with a steel handrail, not modelled: profile request) below, then the 1-storey annexe with a green door at the west end (17), which here takes the block's height.
